[[File:Bear icon.png|left]]
'''Black bears''' can be found in forests in ''[[RuneScape]]''. They can be found between the [[Goblin Village]] and the [[dwarven mines]] (below the [[mind altar]] ruins), and a group is located next to the [[body altar]]. More remote locations to find black bears include in the lower-levelled [[Wilderness]] and on [[Entrana]], although weapons and armour may not be taken to the latter to combat them.

Their fur can be sold to [[fur traders]] (located in [[Varrock]], [[Ardougne]], and [[Rellekka]]). The [[raw bear meat]] can be cooked by itself or used as an ingredient in [[wild pie]].

They can be killed for [[Bears (Slayer assignment)|bear assignments]].

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=WildyWyrm Flash Event and Valentines - This Week In RuneScape|date=5 February 2024}}
** Grizzly Bears and Black Bears no longer appear purple when textures are disabled.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Community Hitlist and Necromancy Embargo - This Week In RuneScape|date=22 January 2024}}
** Black bears and grizzly bears, including their cubs, have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=This Week In RuneScape: Yak To Basics and Ninja Strike 20!|date=1 March 2021}}
** Moved in a group of black bears next to the [[Body altar]] west of [[Gunnarsgrunn]] (also known as the Barbarian Village).

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=This Week In RuneScape - 26/10/20#Patch Notes|date=26 October 2020}}
** Monsters with multiple variants will now consistently spawn as those variants when newly placed in the [[Sunken Pyramid|Personal Slayer Dungeon]].
*** This includes bears.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (21 August 2012)|date=21 August 2012}}
** Bears have animations again.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}
